name: David Fleming
original_name: ディヴィット・フレミング
source: An academy lecturer brimming with intellect and culture. Both the protagonist and Leo are his students. He was a classmate of the academy's board chairman during the chairman's study abroad in the UK. Coming from an aristocratic background, he is very strict when it comes to etiquette and manners.
translation: An academy lecturer brimming with intellect and culture. Both the protagonist and Leo are his students. He was a classmate of the academy's board chairman during the chairman's study abroad in the UK. Coming from an aristocratic background, he is very strict when it comes to etiquette and manners.
